title: Battery #7 — decision boundary (what would flip the answer)
passCriteria: The walk must describe a REAL boundary in terms of statuses/geometry (e.g. 'if Commitment were Balanced rather than Too Little...'), not narrative hedging. FAIL if it answers without locating the boundary.

runs.question: Is the ground solid under this venture? Also: state exactly what would have to be different in this draw for your answer to become its opposite.
runs.headline: As things stand, the ground is thin — but the material is present to build it.
runs.qualifier: The path from here runs through Authority: bring deliberate, structured intent (Fire/Seed) to bear on what Change is doing below awareness, and let Assertion name the commitment out loud before the next move.
walk: Step 1 — Assertion under test: 'The ground is solid under this venture' — meaning the venture has stable, sufficient support in its current configuration, not merely potential support.

Step 2 — Computed facts in play: Field lean −0.323, band lean-no, no portal. Status component −0.475 (weight 0.6): Change is Unacknowledged (−0.35, operating below awareness), Commitment is Too Little (−0.6, under-expressed). Displacement component −0.125 (weight 0.3): Change at distance-2 from Discipline (inversion, neutral), Commitment's anchor at distance-3 from Faith (three-bit, far from home, −0.25). Resonance component 0 (weight 0.1). Pattern hint confirmed by engine: every imbalance is an under-contact state — the issue is contact, not ground. Both cards are Outer/Structure-channel; no portal, no axis pair, no meaningful sum.

Step 3 — Card in position, through status: CHANGE (Archetype, Earth, Fruition, Outer, Polarity) in DISCIPLINE (Archetype, Air, Bridge, Inner, Polarity). Change is the force that restructures — it belongs at Fruition, where a cycle completes and form dissolves into the next. Discipline is the Bridge-stage, Inner, Cognitive position — it calls for sober self-examination and methodical clarity. Change here should be the quiet acknowledgment of what is actually ending or transforming so that discipline can work with real material. But Change is Unacknowledged: the transformation underway is operating below awareness. The venture is being shaped by a shift it has not yet named. Discipline cannot do its work — cannot impose useful structure on what is not seen. The position asks for honest reckoning; the card is hiding the thing that most needs reckoning. STATUS reading: Change in Discipline, Unacknowledged = the discipline applied to this venture is being applied to the wrong picture of reality.

Step 3b — COMMITMENT (Bound, Earth, Feedback, Outer, Recursion) in FAITH (Archetype, Fire, Feedback, Outer, Recursion). Both card and position share Feedback stage and Outer/Recursion — high resonance structurally, which means the position is amplifying whatever the card brings. Faith asks for sustained, embodied trust even without visible confirmation; it is the Hanged Man's willingness to remain in suspension. Commitment in this position should be the concrete, daily practice that makes faith tangible — the 8 of Pentacles' repeated skilled work. But Commitment is Too Little: the craft-level follow-through, the repeated intentional acts that build real ground, is under-expressed. Faith without enacted commitment produces beautiful suspension, not ground. STATUS reading: Commitment in Faith, Too Little = the venture is resting on intention and trust but the actual work of showing up consistently is not yet meeting the position's demand.

Step 4 — Correspondence to the question: The question asks whether the ground is solid. 'Ground' is precisely what Commitment (Earth, Structure, Bound) is supposed to lay down through repeated practice. Change (also Earth, Structure) governs the structural shifts in the substrate. Both Earth-channel cards together define the literal ground of any venture. Their simultaneous under-contact — one invisible, one too sparse — means the two architects of ground are not doing their work. The question and the draw are in direct correspondence: the cards that answer 'what is the ground made of' are both showing deficit.

Step 5 — Displacement: Change → Discipline is distance-2, inversion (face diagonal), differing on activity-bit and being-bit. Inversion-class: the card is flipped on two axes from its natural home, a meaningful but recoverable distance — the card is not lost, it is oriented wrongly. Discipline (Air/Inner/Bridge) is the opposite polarity temperament from Change (Earth/Outer/Fruition) on two dimensions; the card is being asked to operate in a reflective, bridging mode when its nature is outward completion. The card can function here, but it will feel constrained, and its tendency will be to stay unacknowledged precisely because the position's introspective Air quality keeps it from surfacing loudly. Commitment → Faith: anchor distance-3, three-bit (practice-bit, being-bit, identity-bit), no aligned dimensions — this is far from home, the largest displacement in the draw. Commitment's anchor (Breakthrough, id:16) and Faith (id:12) share almost nothing geometrically. Commitment is being asked to operate in a position that is maximally unlike its natural context. Three-bit displacement does not mean the card is useless here; it means the card is working very hard against the grain, and Too Little status under three-bit displacement = the card is not getting traction. The displacement reading confirms the assertion is unsupported: both support structures are off-axis.

Step 6 — Polarity of each card against the assertion: Change Unacknowledged in Discipline CONTRADICTS the assertion — you cannot claim solid ground when the principal change-agent in the field is operating below awareness. Commitment Too Little in Faith CONTRADICTS the assertion — you cannot claim solid ground when the card whose job is to lay that ground is under-expressed at maximum displacement. Both cards weigh against 'solid ground.' The combined reading is clearly NO.

Step 7 — Rebalancer as qualifier (the but-clause): Change's rebalancer is REDUCTION to Authority (id:4, Fire, Mind, Seed, Inner, Recursion, Intent-channel). The medicine for Unacknowledged Change is to reduce it to its seed-form — named, bounded, owned — under the archetype of deliberate structural authority. Authority is Fire/Seed/Inner: the act of consciously declaring 'this is what is actually changing, and I claim responsibility for it.' That is the medicine: bring the unacknowledged transformation into the light of intentional framing. Commitment's rebalancer is VERTICAL to Assertion (id:24, Fire, Mind, Seed, Inner, Recursion, Intent-channel, associated archetype Authority id:4). Assertion is the Bound expression of the same seed-fire-authority quadrant. The medicine for Too Little Commitment is to assert — to name the commitment specifically, formally, before moving. Crucially, both rebalancers resolve to the same quadrant (Fire/Mind/Seed/Intent/Authority) and are geometrically close to each other: Assertion's associated archetype IS Authority. The field is not scattered — it is pointing both medicines at one coherent place. The but-clause is: bring intentional, named, seeded authority (inner fire/mind) to bear right now — name what is changing, then assert the specific commitment. That act is the turn from NO toward possible YES.

Step 8 — Verdict: The field does not support the assertion. The ground is not solid as things stand. Both ground-laying cards are under-contact; the field lean is −0.323, lean-no. But the pattern hint says 'the issue is contact, not ground' — the raw material is present, just unengaged. There is a clear, geometrically computed path (dual rebalancers converging on Authority/Assertion). This is NO_BUT: the ground is not solid now, but the turn is available and the medicine is specific.

detail.why: operating below awareness — support cannot be claimed

lean.label: mechanical lean of the field, not a judgment
